**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity on Bluefly. Every hit for "exclusive" is unrelated to sourcing — § 4.3 (charges "exclusive of" taxes), § 5.2 (exclusive warranties disclaimer), and the nonexclusive licence grants in §§ 5.4 and 12.1. Targeted searches for sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, "shall not procure … from any third party", minimum-commitment and non-compete language returned nothing, and the services (§ 13.1), charges (§ 4.1) and definitions sections contain no sole-source commitment.

Affirmatively, § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) states that "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," which confirms Customer's freedom to buy hosting from other suppliers. Preferred element satisfied; no redline proposed.
